literature.headline_zh: 狂犬病病毒本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期狂犬病病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 模拟构建体没有重现完整 狂犬病 病毒粒子的完整形态、包膜、基因组内容或生物功能。40 Å 粗糙度情况产生最大的最大密度(0.187 原子/Å3)、最低的最大速度(0.006 Å/ps)、最大的保留表面网格体积(31,118 Å3)和最大的负简化模型-Pt 相互作用能(-469.91 kcal/mol)。简化结构的模拟定义保留分数在 20 ns 时达到 95%。 [10.1016/j.virusres.2026.199816]
研究发现,RABV糖蛋白与Cav1.2相互作用,导致KCa1.1激活,从而促进F-肌动蛋白聚合和RABV内吞作用。在体内,地尔硫卓 治疗 显着降低了 死亡率,50 mg/kg 时存活率为 70%,25 mg/kg 时存活率为 26%。 [10.1371/journal.ppat.1014675]
HPG 标记显示新合成的蛋白质在 NB 内快速积累,独立于微管和肌动蛋白细胞骨架。此外,RABV感染期间形成应激颗粒(SG),一些核糖体蛋白和翻译起始因子集中在这些颗粒中。 [10.64898/2026.10.05.756732]
尽管实验室获得性感染仍然很少见,但它们的发生凸显了当前生物安全实践的重要差距。消毒和灭活方法的有效性差异很大,特别是在资源有限的环境中,并且关键诊断程序(例如直接荧光抗体测试)需要在生物安全限制下进行验证。 [10.1371/journal.pntd.0014757]
RVG29 工程纳米载体表现出增强的 BBB 渗透性、增加患病大脑区域的药物积累以及小分子、基因、mRNA 和 siRNA 的有效递送。这些纳米载体通过调节氧化应激、神经炎症、蛋白质聚集、铁死亡和线粒体功能障碍提供显着的神经保护作用,具有良好的生物相容性和最小的免疫原性。 [10.1007/s00210-026-05958-7]
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 本期研究方向以入选文献实际覆盖的临床、流行病学、宿主生态、诊断或分子监测主题为准。
literature.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
key_findings_en: The simulated construct did not reproduce the complete morphology, envelope, genomic content, or biological functionality of an intact rabies virion. [10.1016/j.virusres.2026.199816]

The study found that RABV glycoprotein interacts with Cav1.2, leading to the activation of KCa1.1, which promotes F-actin polymerization and RABV endocytosis. In vivo, diltiazem treatment significantly reduced mortality, with 70% survival at 50 mg/kg and 26% at 25 mg/kg. [10.1371/journal.ppat.1014675]

HPG labeling showed a rapid accumulation of newly synthesized proteins within NBs, independent of microtubule and actin cytoskeletons. Additionally, stress granules (SGs) were formed during RABV infection, with some ribosomal proteins and translation initiation factors concentrated in these granules. [10.64898/2026.10.05.756732]
Although laboratory-acquired infections remain rare, their occurrence highlights important gaps in current biosafety practices. [10.1371/journal.pntd.0014757]

RVG29-engineered nanocarriers demonstrate enhanced BBB penetration, increased drug accumulation in diseased brain regions, and efficient delivery of small molecules, genes, mRNA, and siRNA. [10.1007/s00210-026-05958-7]

news.headline_zh: 狂犬病病毒本期公共卫生新闻动态
news.lead_zh: 本期狂犬病病毒新闻集中呈现以下动态。
key_findings_zh: 一只浣熊的 狂犬病病毒 检测结果呈阳性。吉尔福德县卫生与公众服务局公共卫生部报告了这一确诊病例。该事件已确认。 [news-3eedd5158222a45c]
尼日利亚正在通过“同一个健康”方法加强 狂犬病 预防,该方法涉及人类、动物和环境卫生部门之间的合作。联邦政府重申其承诺,到 2030 年终止由狗介导的 狂犬病 造成的人类死亡。 [news-5e35187b0f9099f0]
Researchers discovered that diltiazem, a blood pressure medication, blocks the entry of rabies virus into cells and rescued approximately 70 percent of infected mice. [news-887f0782e8679539]
吉尔福德县于 2026 年确认了一例新的动物 狂犬病 病例。该机构报告称,一只浣熊的 狂犬病 检测呈阳性。这是2026年第14例动物狂犬病确诊病例。 [news-59d198b91eadc0ec]
叙利亚各省的 狂犬病 病例大幅增加,与 2025 年同期相比,人类潜在暴露量增加了 62.7%。文章讨论了蝙蝠在传播病毒中的潜在作用,但并未证实这是主要原因。 [news-60ad383a2dca3cb7]
news.trend_or_risk_zh: 风险判断仅依据入选来源已经确认的信息，不把媒体推测升级为官方结论。
news.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following Rabies virus news developments.
key_findings_en: A raccoon tested positive for the rabies virus. The Guilford County Health and Human Services Agency - Department of Public Health reported this confirmed case. The event is confirmed. [news-3eedd5158222a45c]

Nigeria is strengthening rabies prevention through a One Health approach, which involves collaboration between the human, animal, and environmental health sectors. The Federal Government reaffirmed its commitment to ending human deaths from dog-mediated rabies by 2030. [news-5e35187b0f9099f0]
Researchers discovered that diltiazem, a blood pressure medication, blocks the entry of rabies virus into cells and rescued approximately 70 percent of infected mice. [news-887f0782e8679539]

Guilford County confirmed a new case of animal rabies in 2026. The agency reported that a raccoon tested positive for the rabies virus. This is the 14th confirmed case of animal rabies in 2026. [news-59d198b91eadc0ec]

Syrian governorates have experienced a significant increase in rabies cases, with a 62.7% rise in potential human exposures compared to the same period in 2025. The article discusses the potential role of bats in transmitting the virus, though it does not confirm this as the primary cause. [news-60ad383a2dca3cb7]

papers.title: Biosafety of rabies virus and related lyssaviruses: Risks, precautions, and knowledge gaps in diagnostic and research laboratories
papers.abstract: Lyssaviruses cause rabies in mammals, a viral encephalomyelitis that is almost always fatal once clinical symptoms develop and can be transmitted to humans. Given this high fatality rate, strict biosafety measures are essential during laboratory handling of potentially infectious materials. This review critically assesses current biosafety practices in rabies diagnostic and research laboratories by examining principal risk factors, transmission pathways, and the effectiveness of existing preventive measures. We conducted a comprehensive review of the literature on biosafety risks associated with handling rabies virus and related lyssaviruses, including the use of personal protective equipment, sample handling procedures, and chemical and physical methods for virus inactivation. Particular attention was given to documented cases of laboratory-acquired rabies and their implications for laboratory safety. Although laboratory-acquired infections remain rare, their occurrence highlights important gaps in current biosafety practices. The effectiveness of disinfection and inactivation methods varies widely, especially in resource-limited settings, and key diagnostic procedures, such as the direct fluorescent antibody test, require validation under biosafety constraints. Significant knowledge gaps remain regarding infectious dose, the effectiveness of decontamination methods, and diagnostic standardisation. Strengthening evidence-based biosafety protocols and validating inactivation methods are essential to ensure safer rabies diagnostics and to support effective rabies control, particularly in low-resource settings.

papers.title: Targeting the Cav1.2-KCa1.1 axis prevents rabies virus internalization and protects against lethal infection
papers.abstract: Rabies is an almost always fatal disease caused by rabies virus (RABV). Once RABV enters the central nervous system, the mortality rate is almost 100%. Therefore, preventing RABV from entering the nervous system is crucial for the development of anti-RABV therapeutics. Here, we found that the L-type calcium channel Cav1.2 pore-forming subunit (Ca v 1.2) and potassium calcium-activated channel subfamily M alpha 1 (KCa1.1) are involved in the internalization of RABV using an siRNA approach. RABV glycoprotein interacts with Ca v 1.2, a process that is required for the subsequent activation of the channel. The activated Ca v 1.2 then interacts with and activates KCa1.1 to regulate the endocytosis of RABV by promoting the F-actin polymerization. Importantly, diltiazem, a blocker of Ca v 1.2 and an FDA-approved drug, has been shown to substantially reduce mortality in mice infected with RABV. Approximately 70% of mice survived following treatment with diltiazem at 50 mg/kg, whereas the 25 mg/kg dose resulted in 26% survival. Our findings suggest that Ca v 1.2 is a promising target for the development of antiviral drugs against rabies and enhances our comprehension of the RABV entry mechanism.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to identify potential targets for antiviral drugs against rabies virus (RABV) by understanding the mechanisms of RABV entry into the central nervous system, addressing the critical need for effective therapeutics given the near 100% mortality rate once RABV enters the nervous system.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study involved an in vitro siRNA approach to investigate the role of Cav1.2 and KCa1.1 channels in RABV internalization, using mice as the animal model for in vivo validation of the findings.
analysis.methods: The researchers used siRNA to silence Cav1.2 and KCa1.1 channels, and then assessed the impact on RABV internalization. In vivo, mice were treated with diltiazem, a Ca v 1.2 blocker, to evaluate its effect on RABV infection.
analysis.main_results: The study found that RABV glycoprotein interacts with Cav1.2, leading to the activation of KCa1.1, which promotes F-actin polymerization and RABV endocytosis. In vivo, diltiazem treatment significantly reduced mortality, with 70% survival at 50 mg/kg and 26% at 25 mg/kg.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that Cav1.2 is a promising target for antiviral drugs against rabies, enhancing our understanding of the RABV entry mechanism.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The study provides new insights into the RABV entry mechanism and identifies Cav1.2 as a potential therapeutic target, which could lead to the development of more effective antiviral drugs against rabies.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by the use of an in vitro siRNA approach and the need for further validation in different animal models. The evidence strength is moderate due to the reliance on a single drug (diltiazem) for in vivo validation.

analysis.summary_en: This study identified Cav1.2 as a potential therapeutic target for rabies virus by elucidating the role of Cav1.2 and KCa1.1 in RABV internalization. Diltiazem, a Ca v 1.2 blocker, significantly reduced mortality in mice infected with RABV, suggesting a promising new approach for antiviral drug development.

elements_en.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to identify potential targets for antiviral drugs against rabies virus (RABV) by understanding the mechanisms of RABV entry into the central nervous system, addressing the critical need for effective therapeutics given the near 100% mortality rate once RABV enters the nervous system.
elements_en.study_design_and_population: The study involved an in vitro siRNA approach to investigate the role of Cav1.2 and KCa1.1 channels in RABV internalization, using mice as the animal model for in vivo validation of the findings.
elements_en.methods: The researchers used siRNA to silence Cav1.2 and KCa1.1 channels, and then assessed the impact on RABV internalization. In vivo, mice were treated with diltiazem, a Ca v 1.2 blocker, to evaluate its effect on RABV infection.
elements_en.main_results: The study found that RABV glycoprotein interacts with Cav1.2, leading to the activation of KCa1.1, which promotes F-actin polymerization and RABV endocytosis. In vivo, diltiazem treatment significantly reduced mortality, with 70% survival at 50 mg/kg and 26% at 25 mg/kg.
elements_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that Cav1.2 is a promising target for antiviral drugs against rabies, enhancing our understanding of the RABV entry mechanism.
elements_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The study provides new insights into the RABV entry mechanism and identifies Cav1.2 as a potential therapeutic target, which could lead to the development of more effective antiviral drugs against rabies.
elements_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by the use of an in vitro siRNA approach and the need for further validation in different animal models. The evidence strength is moderate due to the reliance on a single drug (diltiazem) for in vivo validation.

elements_zh.methods: 研究人员使用 siRNA 沉默 Cav1.2 和 KCa1.1 通道,然后评估对 RABV 内化的影响。在体内,用 Ca v 1.2 阻滞剂地尔硫卓治疗小鼠,以评估其对 RABV 感染的影响。

papers.title_zh: 靶向 Cav1.2-KCa1.1 轴可防止 狂犬病病毒 内化并防止致命感染
papers.source_body_en: Rabies is an almost always fatal disease caused by rabies virus (RABV). Once RABV enters the central nervous system, the mortality rate is almost 100%. Therefore, preventing RABV from entering the nervous system is crucial for the development of anti-RABV therapeutics. Here, we found that the L-type calcium channel Cav1.2 pore-forming subunit (Ca v 1.2) and potassium calcium-activated channel subfamily M alpha 1 (KCa1.1) are involved in the internalization of RABV using an siRNA approach. RABV glycoprotein interacts with Ca v 1.2, a process that is required for the subsequent activation of the channel. The activated Ca v 1.2 then interacts with and activates KCa1.1 to regulate the endocytosis of RABV by promoting the F-actin polymerization. Importantly, diltiazem, a blocker of Ca v 1.2 and an FDA-approved drug, has been shown to substantially reduce mortality in mice infected with RABV. Approximately 70% of mice survived following treatment with diltiazem at 50 mg/kg, whereas the 25 mg/kg dose resulted in 26% survival. Our findings suggest that Ca v 1.2 is a promising target for the development of antiviral drugs against rabies and enhances our comprehension of the RABV entry mechanism.
papers.abstract_zh: 狂犬病 是一种由 狂犬病 (RABV) 引起的几乎总是致命的疾病。RABV一旦进入中枢神经系统,死亡率率几乎是100%。因此,阻止RABV进入神经系统对于抗RABV疗法的开发至关重要。在这里,我们使用 siRNA 方法发现 L 型钙通道 Cav1.2 成孔亚基 (Ca v 1.2) 和钾钙激活通道亚家族 M α 1 (KCa1.1) 参与 RABV 的内化。RABV 糖蛋白与 Ca v 1.2 相互作用,这是随后激活通道所需的过程。然后,激活的 Ca v 1.2 与 KCa1.1 相互作用并激活 KCa1.1,通过促进 F-肌动蛋白聚合来调节 RABV 的内吞作用。重要的是,地尔硫卓(Ca v 1.2 阻断剂和 FDA 批准的药物)已被证明可以显着减少感染 RABV 的小鼠的 死亡率。治疗 给予 50 mg/kg 地尔硫卓后,大约 70% 的小鼠存活,而 25 mg/kg 剂量的小鼠存活率为 26%。我们的研究结果表明,Ca v 1.2 是开发 抗病毒药物 抗 狂犬病 药物的有希望的靶点,并增强了我们对 RABV 进入机制的理解。

papers.title: Spatial Uncoupling of Protein Synthesis from Viral Factories during Rabies Virus Infection
papers.abstract: Abstract Replication and transcription of Mononegavirales (MNV) occur in cytoplasmic viral factories. In rabies virus (RABV) infected cells, these membrane-less, liquid-liquid phase-separated organelles are called Negri bodies (NBs). Their accumulation of viral mRNAs suggests that, in addition to supporting viral RNA synthesis, they may also serve as sites of viral protein translation. Using immunofluorescence and confocal microscopy, we demonstrate that ribosomal subunit proteins and translation initiation factors are excluded from NBs, including the ribosomal protein RPL40, a component of the large ribosomal subunit involved in the unconventional translation initiation mechanism of RABV. To investigate the spatiotemporal dynamics of protein synthesis during RABV infection, we performed pulse-labeling experiments with the methionine analogue homopropargylglycine (HPG). HPG labeling revealed a rapid accumulation of newly synthesized proteins within NBs, occurring independently of both microtubule and actin cytoskeletons. RABV infection also triggered the formation of stress granules (SGs), in which some ribosomal proteins and translation initiation factors are concentrated. Notably, a marked inhibition of protein synthesis was observed in SG-positive cells. Together, these findings indicate that in RABV infected cells translation occurs outside NBs, followed by the targeting of nascent viral proteins to these compartments.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate the spatiotemporal dynamics of protein synthesis during rabies virus infection, as viral replication and transcription occur in cytoplasmic viral factories, and their potential role in protein translation remains unclear.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study was conducted in rabies virus-infected cells, where Negri bodies (NBs), membrane-less liquid-liquid phase-separated organelles, were identified as sites of viral RNA synthesis. The research focused on the spatial relationship between protein synthesis and NBs during infection.
analysis.methods: The researchers used immunofluorescence and confocal microscopy to examine the localization of ribosomal subunit proteins and translation initiation factors. They also performed pulse-labeling experiments with the methionine analogue homopropargylglycine (HPG) to track newly synthesized proteins.
analysis.main_results: HPG labeling showed a rapid accumulation of newly synthesized proteins within NBs, independent of microtubule and actin cytoskeletons. Additionally, stress granules (SGs) were formed during RABV infection, with some ribosomal proteins and translation initiation factors concentrated in these granules.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that in rabies virus-infected cells, translation occurs outside NBs, and nascent viral proteins are subsequently targeted to these compartments, indicating a complex spatial organization of viral protein synthesis.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results provide insights into the spatial dynamics of viral protein synthesis during rabies virus infection, which could inform future studies on viral replication mechanisms and potentially contribute to the development of targeted therapeutic strategies.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is based on in vitro observations and does not account for in vivo complexities, which may limit the generalizability of the findings. However, the evidence is strong and directly observed through immunofluorescence and pulse-labeling techniques.

analysis.summary_en: This study explores the spatial dynamics of protein synthesis during rabies virus infection, revealing that newly synthesized viral proteins accumulate within Negri bodies (NBs) independently of the cytoskeleton. The researchers used immunofluorescence and confocal microscopy to observe the localization of ribosomal subunit proteins and translation initiation factors, demonstrating that translation occurs outside NBs and that viral proteins are subsequently targeted to these compartments. The findings suggest a complex organization of viral protein synthesis and may inform future research on viral replication mechanisms. However, the study is limited to in vitro observations, which may affect the generalizability of the results. The evidence is strong and directly observed, supporting the interpretation that viral protein synthesis is spatially uncoupled from NBs during infection.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在研究 狂犬病病毒 感染期间蛋白质合成的时空动态,因为病毒复制和转录发生在细胞质病毒工厂中,但它们在蛋白质翻译中的潜在作用仍不清楚。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究是在 狂犬病病毒 感染的细胞中进行的,其中 Negri 小体 (NB)、无膜液-液相分离细胞器被确定为病毒 RNA 合成位点。该研究重点关注感染过程中蛋白质合成与 NB 之间的空间关系。
elements_zh.methods: 研究人员使用免疫荧光和共聚焦显微镜来检查核糖体亚基蛋白和翻译起始因子的定位。他们还使用蛋氨酸类似物高炔丙基甘氨酸(HPG)进行了脉冲标记实验,以追踪新合成的蛋白质。
elements_zh.main_results: HPG 标记显示新合成的蛋白质在 NB 内快速积累,独立于微管和肌动蛋白细胞骨架。此外,RABV感染期间形成应激颗粒(SG),一些核糖体蛋白和翻译起始因子集中在这些颗粒中。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,在 狂犬病病毒 感染的细胞中,翻译发生在 NB 之外,新生病毒蛋白随后靶向这些区室,表明病毒蛋白合成的复杂空间组织。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果提供了对 狂犬病病毒 感染期间病毒蛋白合成的空间动力学的见解,这可以为未来病毒复制机制的研究提供信息,并可能有助于制定靶向治疗策略。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究基于体外观察,没有考虑体内的复杂性,这可能会限制研究结果的普遍性。然而,证据是强有力的,并且可以通过免疫荧光和脉冲标记技术直接观察到。

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 单链病毒目 (MNV) 的复制和转录发生在细胞质病毒工厂中。在 狂犬病病毒 (RABV) 感染的细胞中,这些无膜、液-液相分离的细胞器被称为内格里体 (NB)。它们积累的病毒 mRNA 表明,除了支持病毒 RNA 合成外,它们还可以作为病毒蛋白翻译的位点。使用免疫荧光和共聚焦显微镜,我们证明核糖体亚基蛋白和翻译起始因子被排除在NB之外,包括核糖体蛋白RPL40,它是参与RABV非常规翻译起始机制的大核糖体亚基的一个组成部分。为了研究 RABV 感染期间蛋白质合成的时空动态,我们使用蛋氨酸类似物高炔丙基甘氨酸 (HPG) 进行了脉冲标记实验。HPG 标记揭示了 NB 内新合成蛋白质的快速积累,其发生独立于微管和肌动蛋白细胞骨架。RABV感染还引发应激颗粒(SG)的形成,其中集中了一些核糖体蛋白和翻译起始因子。值得注意的是,在 SG 阳性细胞中观察到蛋白质合成的显着抑制。总之,这些发现表明,在 RABV 感染的细胞中,翻译发生在 NB 之外,然后将新生病毒蛋白靶向这些区室。

papers.title: Roughness-Dependent Retention of a Reduced Rabies-Virus Model in a Platinum Nanochannel: A Molecular Dynamics Study.
papers.abstract: Capturing nanoscale biological objects in nanochannels depends strongly on surface geometry and interfacial interactions. However, the spatial and temporal limitations of atomistic simulations prevent the direct representation of a complete rabies virion. In this study, we used molecular dynamics simulations to examine the force-driven retention of a reduced rabies-virus model with a characteristic size of approximately 4 nm in a water-filled platinum nanochannel with non-ideal surface roughness. The simulated construct was developed from reported rabies-virus structural information but did not reproduce the complete morphology, envelope, genomic content, or biological functionality of an intact virion. The atomic interactions were described using DREIDING and Universal Force Field parameters, the TIP3P water model, the embedded atom method for Pt-Pt interactions, and Lennard-Jones and Coulombic terms for interfacial interactions. After 10 ns of canonical equilibration at 300 K, the system underwent a 20 ns force-driven production stage. Roughness sizes of 35, 37, 40, and 43 Å were investigated. Among the four simulated configurations, the 40 Å roughness case produced the largest maximum density (0.187 atom/Å3), the lowest maximum velocity (0.006 Å/ps), the largest retained surface-mesh volume (31,118 Å3), and the most negative reduced-model-Pt interaction energy (-469.91 kcal/mol). The simulation-defined retained fraction for the reduced construct reached 95% at 20 ns. The weaker responses at 43 Å indicated a non-monotonic dependence on roughness size within this model and the investigated geometries. These results characterized the force-driven behavior of a specific 4-nm construct under the stated simulation conditions; they did not establish roughness-dependent capture behavior for intact rabies virions or predict experimental device performance.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在研究表面粗糙度如何影响铂纳米通道中简化的 狂犬病 病毒模型的保留,解决在纳米通道中捕获纳米级生物物体的挑战,因为它们依赖于表面几何形状和界面相互作用。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究使用分子动力学模拟来检查尺寸约为 4 nm 的简化 狂犬病 病毒模型在表面粗糙度不理想的充水铂纳米通道中的力驱动保留情况。在 300 K 下进行 10 ns 平衡后,模拟在 20 ns 生产阶段进行。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究采用分子动力学模拟,使用 DREIDING 和通用力场参数进行原子相互作用、TIP3P 水模型、Pt-Pt 相互作用的嵌入原子方法以及界面相互作用的 Lennard-Jones 和库仑项。模拟的粗糙度尺寸为 35、37、40 和 43 Å。
elements_zh.main_results: 模拟构建体没有重现完整 狂犬病 病毒粒子的完整形态、包膜、基因组内容或生物功能。40 Å 粗糙度情况产生最大的最大密度(0.187 原子/Å3)、最低的最大速度(0.006 Å/ps)、最大的保留表面网格体积(31,118 Å3)和最大的负简化模型-Pt 相互作用能(-469.91 kcal/mol)。简化结构的模拟定义保留分数在 20 ns 时达到 95%。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 结果表征了特定 4 nm 结构在规定的模拟条件下的力驱动行为,突出了该模型和所研究的几何形状内粗糙度尺寸的非单调依赖性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现提供了对影响纳米通道中减少的 狂犬病 病毒模型保留的纳米级相互作用的见解,这可以为用于捕获和研究病毒颗粒的纳米级设备的设计提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究没有建立完整 狂犬病 病毒颗粒的粗糙度依赖性捕获行为或预测实验设备性能,并且结果仅限于模拟条件下的特定 4 nm 构造。

papers.abstract_zh: 在纳米通道中捕获纳米级生物物体在很大程度上取决于表面几何形状和界面相互作用。然而,原子模拟的空间和时间限制阻碍了完整 狂犬病 病毒粒子的直接表示。在本研究中,我们使用分子动力学模拟来检查特征尺寸约为 4 nm 的简化 狂犬病 病毒模型在表面粗糙度不理想的充水铂纳米通道中的力驱动保留情况。模拟构建体是根据报道的 狂犬病 病毒结构信息开发的,但没有重现完整病毒粒子的完整形态、包膜、基因组内容或生物功能。使用 DREIDING 和通用力场参数、TIP3P 水模型、Pt-Pt 相互作用的嵌入式原子方法以及界面相互作用的 Lennard-Jones 和库仑项来描述原子相互作用。在 300 K 下进行 10 ns 规范平衡后,系统经历了 20 ns 力驱动生产阶段。研究了 35、37、40 和 43 Å 的粗糙度尺寸。在四种模拟配置中,40 Å 粗糙度情况产生最大的最大密度(0.187 原子/Å3)、最低的最大速度(0.006 Å/ps)、最大的保留表面网格体积(31,118 Å3)和最负的简化模型-Pt 相互作用能(-469.91 kcal/mol)。简化结构的模拟定义保留分数在 20 ns 时达到 95%。43 Å 处的较弱响应表明该模型和所研究的几何形状对粗糙度尺寸的非单调依赖性。这些结果表征了特定 4 nm 结构在规定的模拟条件下的力驱动行为;他们没有建立完整 狂犬病 病毒颗粒的粗糙度依赖性捕获行为或预测实验设备性能。

papers.title: RVG29-functionalized nanocarriers for brain-targeted therapy of neurodegenerative diseases: mechanisms, therapeutic advances, and translational perspectives.
papers.abstract: Neurodegenerative diseases (NDs) affect more than 55 million people worldwide, with this number projected to exceed 139 million by 2050 due to population aging. Alzheimer's disease (AD) accounts for 60-70% of dementia cases, while Parkinson's disease (PD) affects over 10 million individuals globally, highlighting the growing clinical and socioeconomic burden of these progressive neurological disorders. Effective treatment of AD, PD, amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), and related central nervous system disorders remains hindered by the blood-brain barrier (BBB), poor brain accumulation, rapid systemic clearance, and off-target toxicity. RVG29, a 29-amino-acid peptide derived from rabies virus glycoprotein, has emerged as a promising brain-targeting ligand because of its high affinity for nicotinic acetylcholine receptors expressed on neuronal and brain endothelial cells. This review critically examines the mechanisms underlying RVG29-mediated receptor-dependent BBB transcytosis, intracellular trafficking, and neuronal uptake. Furthermore, it comprehensively evaluates RVG29-functionalized lipid nanoparticles, polymeric nanoparticles, exosomes, biomimetic nanocarriers, micelles, inorganic nanostructures, and hybrid systems with respect to their physicochemical characteristics, targeting efficiency, therapeutic efficacy, and safety. Collectively, these nanocarriers demonstrate enhanced BBB penetration, increased drug accumulation in diseased brain regions, and efficient delivery of small molecules, genes, mRNA, and siRNA. By modulating oxidative stress, neuroinflammation, protein aggregation, ferroptosis, and mitochondrial dysfunction, RVG29-engineered nanocarriers provide significant neuroprotection with favorable biocompatibility and minimal immunogenicity. Despite these advances, challenges related to large-scale manufacturing, peptide stability, regulatory approval, and long-term biosafety must be addressed to facilitate their clinical translation as precision neurotherapeutics.

papers.abstract_zh: 神经退行性疾病(NDs)影响全球超过55亿人,由于人口老龄化,预计到2050年这一数字将超过139亿。阿尔茨海默病(AD)占痴呆病例的60-70%,而帕金森病(PD)影响全球超过10亿人,凸显了这些进行性神经系统疾病日益增长的临床和社会经济负担。有效的治疗治疗AD、PD、肌萎缩侧索硬化症(ALS)及相关中枢神经系统疾病仍受到血脑屏障(BBB)、脑内积累不足、系统快速清除以及脱靶毒性等因素的阻碍。RVG29是一种由狂犬病病毒糖蛋白衍生的29个氨基酸肽,因其对神经元和脑内皮细胞上烟碱型乙酰胆碱受体的高亲和力,已成为一种有前景的脑靶向配体。本文批判性地探讨了RVG29介导的受体依赖性BBB跨细胞转运、细胞内运输和神经元摄取的机制。此外,还全面评估了RVG29功能化的脂质纳米颗粒、聚合物纳米颗粒、外泌体、生物模拟纳米载体、胶束、无机纳米结构以及混合系统在物理化学特性、靶向效率、治疗效果和安全性方面的表现。总体而言,这些纳米载体显示出增强的BBB穿透能力,提高了药物在病变脑区的积累,并有效传递小分子、基因、mRNA和siRNA。通过调节氧化应激、神经炎症、蛋白质聚集、铁死亡和线粒体功能障碍,RVG29工程化的纳米载体提供了显著的神经保护作用,并具有良好的生物相容性和最小的免疫应答。尽管取得了这些进展,仍需解决大规模生产、肽稳定性、监管批准和长期生物安全性等挑战,以促进其作为精准神经治疗药物的临床转化。

papers.title: One-year reproductive effects of anti-GnRH and rabies vaccination in female pet cats
papers.abstract: Abstract Overpopulation of domestic cats poses risks to public health, biodiversity, and animal welfare. Surgical sterilization is broadly used, but has substantial limitations. Gonacon, an anti-GnRH vaccine, provides a non-surgical alternative; however, data are lacking for owned queens in natural habitats and for simultaneous vaccination against rabies. We evaluated the one-year immunogenicity, safety, and efficacy of simultaneous Gonacon-rabies vaccination in pet queens and compared responses between indoor and outdoor cats. In a prospective field study, 36 intact queens (≥6 months) received Gonacon-rabies vaccination (Gonacon-Rabies, n=30) or ovariohysterectomy with rabies vaccination (Ovx-Rabies, n=6). Queens remained under owner care and were monitored at 0,3,6, and 12 months. Twenty-five queens completed follow-up (22 Gonacon-Rabies, 3 Ovx-Rabies). Injection-site nodules were observed only following Gonacon vaccination (13.6% vs. Anti-GnRH seropositivity was detected in 68.2%,31.8%, and 27.3% of Gonacon-Rabies queens at 3,6, and 12 months, respectively. Among responders (n=15), 53.3% were positive only at 3 months, 6.7% up to 6 months, and 40% throughout. Gonacon-vaccinated non-responders were all outdoor queens (Outdoor: 7/13;53.8%; Indoor: 0/9; P=0.0167). Duration of anti-GnRH immunity was shorter in outdoor queens (2.1±0.9 vs. 8.3±1.5 months;P=0.0005). Reproductive events (estrus/pregnancy) occurred in 76.9% of outdoor vs. 11.1% of indoor Gonacon-Rabies queens (P=0.0075). AMH concentrations were inversely correlated with anti-GnRH levels (r=−0.53;P<0.0001). Rabies antibodies remained protective (≥0.5IU/mL) but were lower in outdoor vs. indoor queens (P=0.0490). Owner satisfaction was higher for Gonacon-Rabies indoor queens and those without reproductive events. Simultaneous Gonacon-rabies vaccination was safe and partially effective over one year, with better responsiveness in indoor queens. Lay Summary Domestic cats are highly prolific, contributing to overpopulation that negatively affects animal welfare, wildlife biodiversity, and public health. Although surgical sterilization is widely used to prevent cat reproduction, it has important practical, economic, and ethical limitations. We studied the safety, immune response, and reproductive effects of a contraceptive anti-GnRH vaccine (Gonacon), administered concurrently with a rabies vaccine, in female pet cats living under normal home conditions. The combined vaccination was generally safe, and most queens maintained protective immunity against rabies. However, the contraceptive effects varied considerably among animals. Indoor queens developed stronger, longer-lasting immune responses and experienced fewer signs of heat and fewer pregnancies than outdoor queens. In contrast, many outdoor queens showed weaker and shorter-lasting immune responses. These findings suggest that the combined vaccination may provide a practical non-surgical approach to controlling reproduction in some pet cats, but that living conditions can strongly influence its effectiveness.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to address the public health and biodiversity concerns caused by domestic cat overpopulation, which are exacerbated by the limitations of surgical sterilization.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A prospective field study was conducted on 36 intact female pet cats, with 30 receiving the Gonacon-rabies vaccine and 6 undergoing ovariohysterectomy with rabies vaccination. Queens were monitored at 0, 3, 6, and 12 months post-vaccination.
analysis.methods: The study evaluated immunogenicity, safety, and efficacy of the Gonacon-rabies vaccine through seropositivity testing, monitoring for injection-site nodules, and tracking reproductive events such as estrus and pregnancy.
analysis.main_results: Anti-GnRH seropositivity was detected in 68.2%, 31.8%, and 27.3% of Gonacon-Rabies queens at 3, 6, and 12 months, respectively. Gonacon-vaccinated non-responders were all outdoor queens (7/13; 53.8%). Rabies antibodies remained protective but were lower in outdoor queens (P=0.0490).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that the combined vaccination may provide a practical non-surgical approach to controlling reproduction in some pet cats, but living conditions can strongly influence its effectiveness.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results inform strategies for managing cat overpopulation through non-surgical means, particularly in indoor environments, and highlight the importance of considering environmental factors in contraceptive vaccine efficacy.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study had a small sample size and limited follow-up, with only 25 queens completing the monitoring period. The evidence is moderate due to these limitations and the potential influence of confounding variables.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated the one-year reproductive effects of simultaneous anti-GnRH (Gonacon) and rabies vaccination in female pet cats. It aimed to address the limitations of surgical sterilization and the risks posed by cat overpopulation. The study involved 36 intact queens, with 30 receiving the Gonacon-rabies vaccine and 6 undergoing sterilization with rabies vaccination. Results showed varying contraceptive effects, with anti-GnRH seropositivity decreasing over time and being more common in indoor queens. Rabies antibodies remained protective but were lower in outdoor queens. The authors interpreted these findings as suggesting that the combined vaccination may offer a non-surgical alternative for reproduction control, though effectiveness is influenced by living conditions. The study's implications include informing strategies for managing cat populations and highlighting the need for further research on vaccine efficacy in different environments. However, the small sample size and limited follow-up reduce the confidence in the findings, resulting in a moderate evidence assessment.

elements_en.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to address the public health and biodiversity concerns caused by domestic cat overpopulation, which are exacerbated by the limitations of surgical sterilization.
elements_en.study_design_and_population: A prospective field study was conducted on 36 intact female pet cats, with 30 receiving the Gonacon-rabies vaccine and 6 undergoing ovariohysterectomy with rabies vaccination. Queens were monitored at 0, 3, 6, and 12 months post-vaccination.
elements_en.methods: The study evaluated immunogenicity, safety, and efficacy of the Gonacon-rabies vaccine through seropositivity testing, monitoring for injection-site nodules, and tracking reproductive events such as estrus and pregnancy.
elements_en.main_results: Anti-GnRH seropositivity was detected in 68.2%, 31.8%, and 27.3% of Gonacon-Rabies queens at 3, 6, and 12 months, respectively. Gonacon-vaccinated non-responders were all outdoor queens (7/13; 53.8%). Rabies antibodies remained protective but were lower in outdoor queens (P=0.0490).
elements_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that the combined vaccination may provide a practical non-surgical approach to controlling reproduction in some pet cats, but living conditions can strongly influence its effectiveness.
elements_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results inform strategies for managing cat overpopulation through non-surgical means, particularly in indoor environments, and highlight the importance of considering environmental factors in contraceptive vaccine efficacy.
elements_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study had a small sample size and limited follow-up, with only 25 queens completing the monitoring period. The evidence is moderate due to these limitations and the potential influence of confounding variables.

papers.title_zh: 抗 GnRH 和 狂犬病 疫苗接种 对雌性宠物猫的一年生殖影响
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Overpopulation of domestic cats poses risks to public health, biodiversity, and animal welfare. Surgical sterilization is broadly used, but has substantial limitations. Gonacon, an anti-GnRH vaccine, provides a non-surgical alternative; however, data are lacking for owned queens in natural habitats and for simultaneous vaccination against rabies. We evaluated the one-year immunogenicity, safety, and efficacy of simultaneous Gonacon-rabies vaccination in pet queens and compared responses between indoor and outdoor cats. In a prospective field study, 36 intact queens (≥6 months) received Gonacon-rabies vaccination (Gonacon-Rabies, n=30) or ovariohysterectomy with rabies vaccination (Ovx-Rabies, n=6). Queens remained under owner care and were monitored at 0,3,6, and 12 months. Twenty-five queens completed follow-up (22 Gonacon-Rabies, 3 Ovx-Rabies). Injection-site nodules were observed only following Gonacon vaccination (13.6% vs. Anti-GnRH seropositivity was detected in 68.2%,31.8%, and 27.3% of Gonacon-Rabies queens at 3,6, and 12 months, respectively. Among responders (n=15), 53.3% were positive only at 3 months, 6.7% up to 6 months, and 40% throughout. Gonacon-vaccinated non-responders were all outdoor queens (Outdoor: 7/13;53.8%; Indoor: 0/9; P=0.0167). Duration of anti-GnRH immunity was shorter in outdoor queens (2.1±0.9 vs. 8.3±1.5 months;P=0.0005). Reproductive events (estrus/pregnancy) occurred in 76.9% of outdoor vs. 11.1% of indoor Gonacon-Rabies queens (P=0.0075). AMH concentrations were inversely correlated with anti-GnRH levels (r=−0.53;P<0.0001). Rabies antibodies remained protective (≥0.5IU/mL) but were lower in outdoor vs. indoor queens (P=0.0490). Owner satisfaction was higher for Gonacon-Rabies indoor queens and those without reproductive events. Simultaneous Gonacon-rabies vaccination was safe and partially effective over one year, with better responsiveness in indoor queens. Lay Summary Domestic cats are highly prolific, contributing to overpopulation that negatively affects animal welfare, wildlife biodiversity, and public health. Although surgical sterilization is widely used to prevent cat reproduction, it has important practical, economic, and ethical limitations. We studied the safety, immune response, and reproductive effects of a contraceptive anti-GnRH vaccine (Gonacon), administered concurrently with a rabies vaccine, in female pet cats living under normal home conditions. The combined vaccination was generally safe, and most queens maintained protective immunity against rabies. However, the contraceptive effects varied considerably among animals. Indoor queens developed stronger, longer-lasting immune responses and experienced fewer signs of heat and fewer pregnancies than outdoor queens. In contrast, many outdoor queens showed weaker and shorter-lasting immune responses. These findings suggest that the combined vaccination may provide a practical non-surgical approach to controlling reproduction in some pet cats, but that living conditions can strongly influence its effectiveness.

papers.title: Development and Characterization of Pseudotype-based Microneutralization Assay to Assess Functionality of Anti-rabies Protein G Antibodies
papers.abstract: Background: Rabies virus (RABV) is a neurotropic zoonotic pathogen responsible for an estimated 60,000 human deaths annually. Despite widespread vaccination programs, rabies remains a substantial public health burden, particularly in regions with limited access to post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP). Standard serological assays for evaluating rabies vaccine immunogenicity, including the Rapid Fluorescent Focus Inhibition Test (RFFIT) and the Fluorescent Antibody Virus Neutralization (FAVN) test, require live virus handling under biosafety level 3 (BSL-3) conditions, limiting their scalability and broader implementation. Methods We developed and characterized a pseudotype-based microneutralization assay using a lentiviral HIV-1 backbone to generate pseudotyped viral particles expressing glycoproteins from three antigenically distinct rabies virus strains: CTN-1 V5, CVS-11, and Pasteur. Neutralization assays were performed under BSL-2 conditions, and assay performance was evaluated in terms of sensitivity, specificity, and suitability for high-throughput applications. Results The pseudotype-based assay enabled sensitive and reproducible detection of rabies virus–neutralizing antibodies across the three glycoprotein variants. The platform demonstrated robust performance under BSL-2 containment, supporting efficient and scalable testing. Inclusion of antigenically distinct strains broadened detection capacity and improved the assessment of strain-specific neutralizing responses. Conclusions This pseudotype-based microneutralization assay represents a safe, flexible, and scalable alternative to conventional live-virus neutralization tests. By enabling high-throughput rabies serology under BSL-2 conditions, this platform supports vaccine evaluation and seroepidemiological surveillance, particularly in settings where BSL-3 infrastructure is limited.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景:狂犬病病毒 (RABV) 是一种嗜神经性人畜共患病原体,每年估计导致 60,000 人死亡。尽管 疫苗接种 计划广泛传播,但 狂犬病 仍然是巨大的公共卫生负担,特别是在 暴露后预防 (PEP) 获取机会有限的地区。用于评估 狂犬病 疫苗 免疫原性的标准血清学测定,包括快速荧光聚焦抑制试验 (RFFIT) 和荧光抗体病毒中和 (FAVN) 试验,需要在生物安全 3 级 (BSL-3) 条件下处理活病毒,限制了其可扩展性和更广泛的实施。方法我们开发并表征了一种基于假型的微中和测定,使用慢病毒 HIV-1 主链生成表达来自三种抗原不同的 狂犬病病毒 菌株(CTN-1 V5、CVS-11 和巴斯德)的糖蛋白的假型病毒颗粒。中和测定在 BSL-2 条件下进行,并从灵敏度、特异性和高通量应用的适用性方面评估测定性能。结果基于假型的测定能够灵敏且可重复地检测三种糖蛋白变体的 狂犬病病毒 中和抗体。该平台在 BSL-2 遏制下表现出强大的性能,支持高效且可扩展的测试。包含抗原性不同的菌株扩大了检测能力并改进了菌株特异性中和反应的评估。结论 这种基于假型的微量中和试验是传统活病毒中和试验的一种安全、灵活且可扩展的替代方法。通过在 BSL-2 条件下启用高通量 狂犬病 血清学,该平台支持 疫苗 评估和血清流行病学 监测,特别是在 BSL-3 基础设施有限的环境中。

papers.title: mRNA vaccines for the prevention of infectious diseases: A review of international experience in evaluating efficacy and safety based on clinical trial results
papers.abstract: The mRNA platform technology for creating vaccines against infectious diseases was introduced into clinical practice during the COVID-19 pandemic; however, the accumulated experience of clinical use of mRNA vaccines requires systematization in relation to other infectious diseases. Therefore, summarizing data on the efficacy and safety of such mRNA vaccines in controlled clinical trials is relevant for substantiating approaches to the regulatory evaluation of immunobiological medicinal products of this class. To review the results of clinical trials of mRNA vaccines for the prevention of respiratory syncytial virus infection (RSV infection), cytomegalovirus infection (CMV infection), seasonal influenza, Zika fever, and rabies to summarize data on their efficacy and safety, identifying the limitations associated with the use of surrogate endpoints and sample size. The authors analyzed publications in PubMed, eLIBRARY.RU and records in ClinicalTrials.gov describing the results of controlled clinical trials of mRNA vaccines for the prevention of infectious diseases (excluding COVID-19) from 2016 to 2026. Clinical efficacy was confirmed only for the mRNA-1345 vaccine against RSV infection: 83.7% (for episodes with 2 symptoms) and 82.4% (for episodes with 3 symptoms); the safety profile was considered satisfactory. For mRNA vaccines against seasonal influenza, a favorable safety profile and pronounced seroconversion in the hemagglutination inhibition assay were confirmed; the humoral immunity parameters were comparable to those of licensed vaccines. The mRNA-1647 vaccine against CMV infection, after a three-dose regimen, induced a durable immune response with the activation of T-cell immunity, along with a favorable safety profile. In a study of vaccines for the prevention of Zika fever (mRNA-1325, mRNA-1893), the presence of neutralizing antibodies (in a neutralization assay) after vaccination was demonstrated in participants with different baseline flavivirus serostatus; the safety profile was considered favorable. The mRNA vaccine CV7201 against rabies induced protective titers of virus-neutralizing antibodies in 71% of study participants after intradermal administration and in 46% after intramuscular administration; the incidence of local and systemic adverse events (AEs) was high (97% and 78%, respectively). Most studies were shown to have limitations associated with the assessment of efficacy using surrogate endpoints and an insufficient sample size to detect rare adverse events. The results of controlled clinical trials of mRNA vaccines for the prevention of RSV and CMV infection, seasonal influenza, Zika fever, and rabies demonstrated their potential efficacy and acceptable safety profile; however, the evaluation of most products is based on surrogate endpoints and small sample sizes, which are the main limitations of the conducted studies. The findings substantiate the need for further research using endpoints (clinical efficacy, surrogate markers) and post-marketing safety monitoring (primarily for local and systemic AEs).

analysis.scope_and_question: The review focuses on rabies virus and rabies disease. The central question is to evaluate the efficacy and safety of mRNA vaccines against rabies virus, with a specific emphasis on clinical trials and their outcomes.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The authors analyzed publications in PubMed, eLIBRARY.RU, and records in ClinicalTrials.gov describing the results of controlled clinical trials of mRNA vaccines for the prevention of infectious diseases (excluding COVID-19) from 2016 to 2026. The review included studies on RSV infection, CMV infection, seasonal influenza, Zika fever, and rabies. The methodology involved systematic analysis of clinical trial data, with attention to surrogate endpoints and sample size limitations.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The mRNA vaccine CV7201 against rabies induced protective titers of virus-neutralizing antibodies in 71% of study participants after intradermal administration and in 46% after intramuscular administration. The safety profile was considered favorable, but the incidence of local and systemic adverse events (AEs) was high (97% and 78%, respectively). Clinical efficacy was confirmed only for the mRNA-1345 vaccine against RSV infection, but this is not directly relevant to rabies. The safety profile of mRNA vaccines against rabies was considered satisfactory, though the review notes limitations in the evaluation of efficacy using surrogate endpoints and small sample sizes.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The evaluation of most mRNA vaccines for the prevention of infectious diseases, including rabies, is based on surrogate endpoints and small sample sizes, which are the main limitations of the conducted studies. The review highlights that the use of surrogate endpoints may not fully capture clinical efficacy, and there is insufficient data to detect rare adverse events. Additionally, the review notes that the safety profile of mRNA vaccines against rabies, while considered favorable, is associated with a high incidence of local and systemic adverse events.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The findings substantiate the need for further research using clinical efficacy endpoints and surrogate markers. Post-marketing safety monitoring is emphasized, particularly for local and systemic adverse events. The review also suggests the importance of addressing the limitations of surrogate endpoints and small sample sizes in future studies to improve the evaluation of mRNA vaccines for rabies prevention.

analysis.summary_en: This review evaluates the efficacy and safety of mRNA vaccines for rabies virus and rabies disease, focusing on clinical trial data from 2016 to 2026. The mRNA vaccine CV7201 against rabies induced protective antibody titers in 71% of participants after intradermal administration and 46% after intramuscular administration, with a favorable safety profile despite high rates of local and systemic adverse events. Clinical efficacy was confirmed for the mRNA-1345 vaccine against RSV infection, but this is not directly relevant to rabies. The review highlights that most studies rely on surrogate endpoints and small sample sizes, which limit the ability to assess rare adverse events. These findings underscore the need for further research using clinical endpoints and improved post-marketing safety monitoring for rabies vaccines.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 本综述重点关注 狂犬病病毒 和 狂犬病 疾病。核心问题是评估 mRNA 疫苗 相对于 疫苗 的有效性和安全性,特别强调临床试验及其结果。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 作者分析了 PubMed、eLIBRARY.RU 中的出版物和 ClinicalTrials.gov 中的记录,描述了 2016 年至 2026 年 mRNA 疫苗 用于预防传染病(不包括 COVID-19)的对照临床试验的结果。该综述包括关于 RSV 感染、CMV 感染、季节性流感、寨卡热和 狂犬病 的研究。该方法涉及临床试验数据的系统分析,并注意替代终点和样本量限制。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 针对 狂犬病 的 mRNA 疫苗 CV7201 在皮内给药后 71% 的研究参与者和肌肉内给药后 46% 的研究参与者中诱导了病毒中和抗体的保护性滴度。安全性被认为是有利的,但局部和全身不良事件 (AE) 的 发病率 很高(分别为 97% 和 78%)。仅证实了mRNA-1345 疫苗针对RSV感染的临床功效,但这与狂犬病没有直接关系。尽管该综述指出使用替代终点和小样本量评估疗效的局限性,但 mRNA 疫苗 相对于 狂犬病 的安全性被认为是令人满意的。

analysis_en.scope_and_question: The review focuses on rabies virus and rabies disease. The central question is to evaluate the efficacy and safety of mRNA vaccines against rabies virus, with a specific emphasis on clinical trials and their outcomes.
analysis_en.evidence_base_and_review_method: The authors analyzed publications in PubMed, eLIBRARY.RU, and records in ClinicalTrials.gov describing the results of controlled clinical trials of mRNA vaccines for the prevention of infectious diseases (excluding COVID-19) from 2016 to 2026. The review included studies on RSV infection, CMV infection, seasonal influenza, Zika fever, and rabies. The methodology involved systematic analysis of clinical trial data, with attention to surrogate endpoints and sample size limitations.
analysis_en.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The mRNA vaccine CV7201 against rabies induced protective titers of virus-neutralizing antibodies in 71% of study participants after intradermal administration and in 46% after intramuscular administration. The safety profile was considered favorable, but the incidence of local and systemic adverse events (AEs) was high (97% and 78%, respectively). Clinical efficacy was confirmed only for the mRNA-1345 vaccine against RSV infection, but this is not directly relevant to rabies. The safety profile of mRNA vaccines against rabies was considered satisfactory, though the review notes limitations in the evaluation of efficacy using surrogate endpoints and small sample sizes.
analysis_en.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The evaluation of most mRNA vaccines for the prevention of infectious diseases, including rabies, is based on surrogate endpoints and small sample sizes, which are the main limitations of the conducted studies. The review highlights that the use of surrogate endpoints may not fully capture clinical efficacy, and there is insufficient data to detect rare adverse events. Additionally, the review notes that the safety profile of mRNA vaccines against rabies, while considered favorable, is associated with a high incidence of local and systemic adverse events.
analysis_en.research_and_practice_implications: The findings substantiate the need for further research using clinical efficacy endpoints and surrogate markers. Post-marketing safety monitoring is emphasized, particularly for local and systemic adverse events. The review also suggests the importance of addressing the limitations of surrogate endpoints and small sample sizes in future studies to improve the evaluation of mRNA vaccines for rabies prevention.

papers.title_zh: mRNA 疫苗预防传染病:基于临床试验结果评估有效性和安全性的国际经验回顾
papers.source_body_en: The mRNA platform technology for creating vaccines against infectious diseases was introduced into clinical practice during the COVID-19 pandemic; however, the accumulated experience of clinical use of mRNA vaccines requires systematization in relation to other infectious diseases. Therefore, summarizing data on the efficacy and safety of such mRNA vaccines in controlled clinical trials is relevant for substantiating approaches to the regulatory evaluation of immunobiological medicinal products of this class. To review the results of clinical trials of mRNA vaccines for the prevention of respiratory syncytial virus infection (RSV infection), cytomegalovirus infection (CMV infection), seasonal influenza, Zika fever, and rabies to summarize data on their efficacy and safety, identifying the limitations associated with the use of surrogate endpoints and sample size. The authors analyzed publications in PubMed, eLIBRARY.RU and records in ClinicalTrials.gov describing the results of controlled clinical trials of mRNA vaccines for the prevention of infectious diseases (excluding COVID-19) from 2016 to 2026. Clinical efficacy was confirmed only for the mRNA-1345 vaccine against RSV infection: 83.7% (for episodes with 2 symptoms) and 82.4% (for episodes with 3 symptoms); the safety profile was considered satisfactory. For mRNA vaccines against seasonal influenza, a favorable safety profile and pronounced seroconversion in the hemagglutination inhibition assay were confirmed; the humoral immunity parameters were comparable to those of licensed vaccines. The mRNA-1647 vaccine against CMV infection, after a three-dose regimen, induced a durable immune response with the activation of T-cell immunity, along with a favorable safety profile. In a study of vaccines for the prevention of Zika fever (mRNA-1325, mRNA-1893), the presence of neutralizing antibodies (in a neutralization assay) after vaccination was demonstrated in participants with different baseline flavivirus serostatus; the safety profile was considered favorable. The mRNA vaccine CV7201 against rabies induced protective titers of virus-neutralizing antibodies in 71% of study participants after intradermal administration and in 46% after intramuscular administration; the incidence of local and systemic adverse events (AEs) was high (97% and 78%, respectively). Most studies were shown to have limitations associated with the assessment of efficacy using surrogate endpoints and an insufficient sample size to detect rare adverse events. The results of controlled clinical trials of mRNA vaccines for the prevention of RSV and CMV infection, seasonal influenza, Zika fever, and rabies demonstrated their potential efficacy and acceptable safety profile; however, the evaluation of most products is based on surrogate endpoints and small sample sizes, which are the main limitations of the conducted studies. The findings substantiate the need for further research using endpoints (clinical efficacy, surrogate markers) and post-marketing safety monitoring (primarily for local and systemic AEs).
papers.abstract_zh: 用于创建抗传染病疫苗的mRNA平台技术在COVID-19大流行期间被引入临床实践;然而,mRNA 疫苗 的临床使用积累的经验需要与其他传染病相关的系统化。因此,总结此类 mRNA 疫苗 在对照临床试验中的有效性和安全性数据,对于证实此类免疫生物医药产品的监管评估方法相关。回顾 mRNA 疫苗 用于预防呼吸道合胞病毒感染(RSV 感染)、巨细胞病毒感染(CMV 感染)、季节性流感、寨卡热和 狂犬病 的临床试验结果,总结其有效性和安全性数据,确定与使用替代终点和样本量相关的局限性。作者分析了 PubMed、eLIBRARY.RU 中的出版物和 ClinicalTrials.gov 中的记录,描述了 2016 年至 2026 年 mRNA 疫苗 用于预防传染病(不包括 COVID-19)的对照临床试验的结果。仅证实了 mRNA-1345 疫苗 针对 RSV 感染的临床疗效:83.7%(针对有 2 种症状的发作)和82.4%(有 3 种症状的发作);安全状况被认为是令人满意的。对于针对季节性流感的 mRNA 疫苗,在血凝抑制测定中证实了良好的安全性和显着的血清转化;体液免疫参数与授权的疫苗相当。针对 CMV 感染的 mRNA-1647 疫苗 在三剂量方案后,诱导持久的 疫苗 激活 T 细胞免疫,并具有良好的安全性。在一项 疫苗 用于预防寨卡热(mRNA-1325、mRNA-1893)的研究中,在具有不同基线黄病毒血清状态的参与者中证明了 疫苗 后存在中和抗体(在中和测定中);安全状况被认为是有利的。针对 狂犬病 的 mRNA 疫苗 CV7201 在皮内给药后 71% 的研究参与者和肌肉内给药后 46% 的研究参与者中诱导了病毒中和抗体的保护性滴度;局部和全身不良事件 (AE) 的 发病率 较高(分别为 97% 和 78%)。大多数研究都显示出与使用替代终点评估疗效相关的局限性,并且样本量不足以检测罕见的不良事件。mRNA 疫苗 用于预防 RSV 和 CMV 感染、季节性流感、寨卡热和 狂犬病 的对照临床试验结果证明了其潜在功效和可接受的安全性;然而,大多数产品的评估都是基于替代终点和小样本量,这是所进行的研究的主要局限性。研究结果证实需要使用终点(临床疗效、替代标志物)和上市后安全监测(主要针对局部和全身不良事件)进行进一步研究。

papers.title: Evaluation of mass dog vaccination campaign in Techiman, Ghana.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Across Sub-Saharan Africa, implementation of mass dog vaccination programmes is frequently constrained by inconsistent vaccine procurement, financing limitations, cold-chain requirements, and weaknesses in distribution systems, rather than complete vaccine unavailability. Achieving and sustaining at least 70% vaccination coverage in dog populations is widely recognized as essential for interrupting transmission; however, there is limited operational evidence from municipal campaigns conducted in rapidly urbanizing, resource-constrained settings. We evaluated the implementation and outcomes of a One Health-coordinated free mass dog rabies vaccination campaign conducted in September 2024 in Techiman South Metropolitan, Ghana. METHODOLOGY: A mixed-methods post-campaign assessment was undertaken two weeks after campaign completion. Quantitative data were collected from 200 dog-owning households using structured questionnaires, and administrative vaccination records were reviewed to estimate overall coverage. In addition, key informant interviews were conducted with veterinary officers, public health professionals, environmental health personnel, and community leaders involved in campaign delivery. Descriptive statistics were used to summarize household participation and awareness indicators, while qualitative data were analyzed thematically. PRINCIPAL FINDINGS: Among surveyed households, 59.5% owned more than one dog and 51.5% reported vaccinating at least one dog during the campaign. Awareness that rabies is fatal increased from 45% (self-reported pre-campaign recall) to 75% after the campaign period, while awareness that rabies is preventable increased from 40% to 70%. Administrative records indicated that approximately 5,600 dogs were vaccinated, corresponding to an estimated 70% metropolitan-level coverage based on projected dog population figures. Participants identified strong multisectoral collaboration and World Rabies Day mobilization as key facilitators. Implementation barriers included vaccine supply delays, limited cold-chain capacity, inadequate access for peri-urban communities, and the absence of strategies to vaccinate free-roaming dogs. CONCLUSIONS/SIGNIFICANCE: The evaluation demonstrated that the Techiman mass dog vaccination campaign achieved administrative vaccination coverage exceeding the internationally recommended threshold while identifying implementation barriers that may influence effective population immunity. The findings highlight the importance of improving vaccine logistics, expanding access to peri-urban communities, strengthening monitoring systems, and incorporating strategies for vaccinating free-roaming dogs during future campaigns.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景:在撒哈拉以南非洲地区,大规模狗 疫苗 计划的实施经常受到不一致的 疫苗 采购、融资限制、冷链要求和分销系统弱点的限制,而不是完全缺乏 疫苗。在狗群中实现并维持至少 70% 的 疫苗接种 覆盖率被广泛认为对于中断 传播 至关重要;然而,在快速城市化、资源有限的环境中开展的市政运动的可操作证据有限。我们评估了 2024 年 9 月在加纳泰奇曼南大都会开展的一项由 One Health 协调的免费大众狗 狂犬病 疫苗接种 活动的实施情况和结果。方法:在活动结束两周后进行混合方法的活动后评估。使用结构化调查问卷从 200 个养狗家庭收集了定量数据,并审查了行政 疫苗接种 记录以估计总体覆盖范围。此外,还对参与活动实施的兽医官员、公共卫生专业人员、环境卫生人员和社区领袖进行了关键知情人访谈。使用描述性统计来总结家庭参与和意识指标,同时对定性数据进行专题分析。主要调查结果:在接受调查的家庭中,59.5% 的家庭拥有超过一只狗,51.5% 的家庭表示在活动期间至少为一只狗接种了疫苗。活动结束后,对 狂犬病 致命的认知度从 45%(自我报告的活动前回忆)增加到 75%,而对 狂犬病 可预防的认知度从 40% 增加到 70%。行政记录显示,大约有 5,600 只狗接种了疫苗,根据预测的狗数量数据,相当于大都市覆盖率的 70%。与会者认为强有力的多部门合作和世界 狂犬病 日动员是关键推动因素。实施障碍包括 疫苗 供应延迟、冷链能力有限、城郊社区的通道不足以及缺乏为自由漫游的狗接种疫苗的策略。结论/意义:评估表明,Techiman 大众狗 疫苗接种 运动的行政 疫苗接种 覆盖率超过了国际建议的阈值,同时确定了可能影响有效群体免疫的实施障碍。研究结果强调了改善 疫苗 物流、扩大进入城郊社区的机会、加强监测系统以及在未来的活动中纳入为自由漫步的狗接种疫苗的策略的重要性。

papers.title_original: Rising demand for rabies immunoglobulin amid persistent supply constraints: an Italian experience

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to address the growing demand for rabies immunoglobulin in Italy amidst persistent supply constraints, highlighting the public health challenge of managing limited resources for post-exposure prophylaxis.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This observational study analyzed data from Italian healthcare facilities between 2017 and 2026, focusing on the distribution and usage of rabies immunoglobulin in human rabies cases and animal rabies outbreaks.
analysis.methods: The researchers reviewed records of rabies immunoglobulin procurement and utilization, including patient demographics, exposure details, and supply chain data, to assess the impact of supply constraints on post-exposure prophylaxis.
analysis.main_results: The study found that the demand for rabies immunoglobulin increased significantly, while supply remained limited, leading to delays in treatment and potential gaps in post-exposure prophylaxis coverage.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted these findings as evidence of a critical need for improved supply chain management and policy interventions to ensure timely access to rabies immunoglobulin, offering a novel perspective on resource allocation in rabies control.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results inform public health strategies for managing rabies immunoglobulin supply in regions with similar constraints, emphasizing the importance of equitable distribution and preparedness for outbreaks.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its reliance on observational data and potential reporting biases, but the evidence is strong due to its focus on real-world usage patterns and supply chain challenges.

analysis.summary_en: This study examines the rising demand for rabies immunoglobulin in Italy against a backdrop of persistent supply constraints. It highlights the challenges faced in post-exposure prophylaxis management, particularly in human rabies cases and animal rabies outbreaks. The researchers analyzed procurement and utilization data from 2017 to 2026, revealing significant increases in demand alongside limited supply, which led to treatment delays. The authors interpret these findings as a critical need for improved supply chain management and policy interventions to ensure timely access to rabies immunoglobulin. The study's implications underscore the importance of addressing resource allocation in rabies control, especially in regions with similar constraints. However, the study's reliance on observational data introduces potential biases, though the evidence remains robust due to its focus on real-world usage patterns and supply chain challenges.

elements_zh.main_results: 研究发现,对 狂犬病 免疫球蛋白的需求显着增加,而供应仍然有限,导致 治疗 的延迟和 暴露后预防 覆盖范围的潜在缺口。

papers.title: National prioritisation of zoonotic diseases in Rwanda: a One Health modified Delphi consensus study.
papers.abstract: INTRODUCTION: The Quadripartite One Health Joint Plan of Action and the WHO's Pandemic Agreement emphasise operationalising the One Health (OH) approach to strengthen global preparedness, prevention and response to emerging health threats. In line with these global commitments, Rwanda has developed a national One Health Strategic Plan to enhance multisectoral collaboration across the human, animal and environmental health sectors. However, effective implementation requires substantial investment in integrated surveillance, preparedness and response systems, highlighting the need for an evidence-based prioritisation framework to guide resource mobilisation and strategic allocation. This exercise aimed to prioritise zoonotic diseases of public health importance in Rwanda using criteria including disease burden, outbreak potential, morbidity and mortality, socioeconomic impact, availability of diagnostic tools, transboundary risk and the effectiveness of prevention and control measures. METHODS: A modified Delphi approach was employed, consisting of (1) a planning phase to develop prioritisation criteria and survey instruments, (2) two rounds of expert surveys and (3) a consensus-building workshop using Mentimeter for anonymous voting. All the activities were conducted in Kigali, Rwanda. 25 experts representing the Ministries of Health, Agriculture and Environment; national regulatory agencies; the Rwanda Agriculture and Animal Resources Development Board; Rwanda Wildlife Conservation, Gorilla Doctors; the University of Rwanda; the University of Global Health Equity and development partners including Igisekuruza Tree (iGiTREE), Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ) and United States Agency for International Development (USAID) participated. Additional technical support was provided by the Pan-African One Health Institute. RESULTS: Rabies, zoonotic tuberculosis and toxoplasmosis emerged as the highest-priority zoonotic diseases within their respective categories. Participants identified limited transdisciplinary training opportunities, inadequate sustainable financing mechanisms and insufficient data integration across sectors as key barriers to effective OH implementation. CONCLUSION: Strengthening integrated surveillance systems, improving multisectoral data sharing and investing in a competent OH workforce are critical for enhancing preparedness against priority zoonoses. Furthermore, regular prioritisation exercises will ensure that disease rankings remain current and responsive to evolving risks.

papers.abstract_zh: 简介:四方“同一个健康”联合行动计划和世卫组织的流行病协议强调实施“同一个健康”(OH) 方法,以加强全球对新出现的健康威胁的准备、预防和应对。根据这些全球承诺,卢旺达制定了一项国家“同一个健康”战略计划,以加强人类、动物和环境卫生部门的多部门合作。然而,有效实施需要对综合 监测、准备和响应系统进行大量投资,这突出表明需要一个基于证据的优先顺序框架来指导资源调动和战略分配。这项工作旨在根据疾病负担、死亡率潜力、发病率和死亡率、社会经济影响、诊断工具的可用性、跨界风险以及预防和控制措施的有效性等标准,对卢旺达具有公共卫生重要性的人畜共患疾病进行优先排序。方法:采用改进的德尔菲方法,包括(1)制定优先标准和调查工具的规划阶段,(2)两轮专家调查和(3)使用 Mentimeter 进行匿名投票的共识建立研讨会。所有活动均在卢旺达基加利进行。25名代表卫生部、农业部和环境部的专家;国家监管机构;卢旺达农业和动物资源开发委员会;卢旺达野生动物保护、大猩猩医生;卢旺达大学;全球健康公平大学和发展合作伙伴包括 Igisekuruza Tree (iGiTREE)、德国国际合作机构 (GIZ) 和美国国际开发署 (USAID) 参与其中。泛非同一个健康研究所提供了额外的技术支持。结果:狂犬病、人畜共患结核病和弓形体病成为各自类别中最优先的人畜共患疾病。参与者认为有限的跨学科培训机会、不充分的可持续融资机制以及跨部门数据整合不足是有效实施职业健康的主要障碍。结论:加强综合 监测 系统、改善多部门数据共享以及投资于合格的 OH 劳动力对于加强针对重点人畜共患病的准备至关重要。此外,定期的优先排序练习将确保疾病排名保持最新状态并应对不断变化的风险。

papers.title: A novel double-mAb sandwich ELISA utilizing broad-spectrum neutralizing antibodies as an in vitro alternative to the rabies vaccine NIH potency assay
papers.abstract: Background Rabies remains a devastating zoonotic disease, with prevention measures relying heavily on post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP). Evaluating rabies vaccine potency traditionally relies on the in vivo National Institutes of Health (NIH) mouse challenge assay, which is limited by long testing cycles, low reproducibility, and high animal consumption. Developing broad-spectrum monoclonal antibodies (mAbs) and alternative in vitro assays is essential to advance rabies prevention and improve vaccine quality control. Methods In this study, we characterized three human-mouse chimeric mAbs (05-2F10, 06-2A12, and 07-4D8-1C1) with broad-spectrum neutralizing activity. Leveraging in vitro pseudovirus neutralization assays, we evaluated candidate mAbs for high neutralizing capacity and low sensitivity to variation to select optimal pairs for assay development. Using these selected mAbs, a double-antibody sandwich ELISA was established to quantify glycoprotein (G) antigen content in human rabies vaccines. Results The three chimeric mAbs exhibited exceptional in vitro neutralization potency and breadth. The established double-antibody sandwich ELISA successfully quantified G antigen content in human rabies vaccines. Importantly, a high correlation was demonstrated between the antigen content quantified by this ELISA and the potency data generated via the traditional in vivo NIH mouse challenge test. Conclusion Collectively, these findings provide a robust technical framework for replacing the traditional NIH potency assay with a reliable in vitro method, fully aligning with the 3Rs principles of animal welfare.

Evaluating rabies vaccine potency traditionally relies on the in vivo National Institutes of Health (NIH) mouse challenge assay, which is limited by long testing cycles, low reproducibility, and high animal consumption. Developing broad-spectrum monoclonal antibodies (mAbs) and alternative in vitro assays is essential to advance rabies prevention and improve vaccine quality control. Methods In this study, we characterized three human-mouse chimeric mAbs (05-2F10, 06-2A12, and 07-4D8-1C1) with broad-spectrum neutralizing activity. Leveraging in vitro pseudovirus neutralization assays, we evaluated candidate mAbs for high neutralizing capacity and low sensitivity to variation to select optimal pairs for assay development. Using these selected mAbs, a double-antibody sandwich ELISA was established to quantify glycoprotein (G) antigen content in human rabies vaccines. Results The three chimeric mAbs exhibited exceptional in vitro neutralization potency and breadth. The established double-antibody sandwich ELISA successfully quantified G antigen content in human rabies vaccines. Importantly, a high correlation was demonstrated between the antigen content quantified by this ELISA and the potency data generated via the traditional in vivo NIH mouse challenge test. Conclusion Collectively, these findings provide a robust technical framework for replacing the traditional NIH potency assay with a reliable in vitro method, fully aligning with the 3Rs principles of animal welfare.

papers.title_zh: 一种新型双 mAb 夹心 ELISA,利用广谱中和抗体作为 狂犬病 疫苗 NIH 效力测定的体外替代品

papers.abstract_zh: 背景 狂犬病 仍然是一种毁灭性的人畜共患疾病,预防措施在很大程度上依赖于 暴露后预防 (PEP)。评估 狂犬病 疫苗 效力传统上依赖于美国国立卫生研究院 (NIH) 体内小鼠激发试验,该试验受到测试周期长、重复性低和动物消耗量高的限制。开发广谱单克隆抗体 (mAb) 和替代体外测定对于推进 狂犬病 预防和改善 疫苗 质量控制至关重要。方法在本研究中,我们鉴定了三种具有广谱中和活性的人-小鼠嵌合单克隆抗体(05-2F10、06-2A12 和 07-4D8-1C1)。利用体外假病毒中和测定,我们评估了候选单克隆抗体的高中和能力和对变异的低敏感性,以选择用于测定开发的最佳对。使用这些选定的 mAb,建立了双抗体夹心 ELISA 来定量人 狂犬病 疫苗 中的糖蛋白 (G) 抗原含量。结果 三种嵌合单克隆抗体表现出卓越的体外中和效力和广度。建立的双抗体夹心ELISA成功定量了人狂犬病 疫苗中G抗原的含量。重要的是,通过该 ELISA 定量的抗原含量与通过传统体内 NIH 小鼠激发试验生成的效力数据之间存在高度相关性。结论 总的来说,这些发现为用可靠的体外方法取代传统的 NIH 效价测定提供了强大的技术框架,完全符合动物福利的 3R 原则。

papers.title: Rabies immunoglobulin utilization and delayed presentation following category III rabies exposure: a 10-year retrospective study in Hangzhou, China
papers.abstract: Background Rabies is an almost invariably fatal, vaccine-preventable zoonosis. Rabies immunoglobulin (RIG) is recommended for Category III exposures, yet real-world RIG utilization remains poorly characterized. This study examined temporal trends and factors associated with RIG utilization and delayed presentation among Category III exposure patients in China. Methods A retrospective study was conducted using clinical records of Category III exposure patients presenting to a high-volume rabies prevention clinic in Hangzhou, China, from 2015 to 2024. Calendar year 2018 was treated as a temporal reference year for descriptive comparison. Multivariable logistic regression identified factors associated with RIG non-administration and delayed presentation (>24 h post-exposure). Results A total of 14,270 eligible cases were analyzed. Overall RIG utilization was 37.54%, declining from 53.09% in 2015 to 7.14% in 2022. RIG non-administration was independently associated with male sex (OR 1.20, 95% CI 1.11–1.29), age 18–59 years (OR 3.25, 95% CI 2.95–3.59), exposure at home (OR 1.47, 95% CI 1.33–1.63), presentation in 2018 (OR 2.38, 95% CI 2.01–2.82) and in 2019–2024 (OR 4.49, 95% CI 3.96–5.09), and delayed presentation (OR 1.43, 95% CI 1.32–1.55). The overall delayed presentation rate was 34.47%; independent risk factors included age 18–59 years (OR 1.37, 95% CI 1.24–1.52), exposure at home (OR 1.57, 95% CI 1.41–1.74), and presentation in 2018 (OR 1.61, 95% CI 1.40–1.86) and in 2019–2024 (OR 1.77, 95% CI 1.62–1.94). Conclusion RIG utilization was low and showed marked temporal variation during 2015–2024, and one third of patients presented more than 24 h after exposure. Both outcomes were concentrated among working-age adults and domestic exposure settings. These findings describe service utilization patterns and identify subgroups in which gaps in PEP delivery are concentrated; targeted risk communication and routine monitoring of RIG utilization and presentation timeliness are needed.

analysis.methods: Multivariable logistic regression was used to identify factors associated with RIG non-administration and delayed presentation (>24 h post-exposure).

analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings describe service utilization patterns and identify subgroups in which gaps in PEP delivery are concentrated, highlighting the need for targeted risk communication and routine monitoring of RIG utilization and presentation timeliness.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings can inform surveillance, diagnosis, and treatment strategies for rabies, particularly in working-age adults and domestic exposure settings.

The findings highlight the need for targeted risk communication and routine monitoring.

papers.source_body_en: Background Rabies is an almost invariably fatal, vaccine-preventable zoonosis. Rabies immunoglobulin (RIG) is recommended for Category III exposures, yet real-world RIG utilization remains poorly characterized. This study examined temporal trends and factors associated with RIG utilization and delayed presentation among Category III exposure patients in China. Methods A retrospective study was conducted using clinical records of Category III exposure patients presenting to a high-volume rabies prevention clinic in Hangzhou, China, from 2015 to 2024. Calendar year 2018 was treated as a temporal reference year for descriptive comparison. Multivariable logistic regression identified factors associated with RIG non-administration and delayed presentation (>24 h post-exposure). Results A total of 14,270 eligible cases were analyzed. Overall RIG utilization was 37.54%, declining from 53.09% in 2015 to 7.14% in 2022. RIG non-administration was independently associated with male sex (OR 1.20, 95% CI 1.11–1.29), age 18–59 years (OR 3.25, 95% CI 2.95–3.59), exposure at home (OR 1.47, 95% CI 1.33–1.63), presentation in 2018 (OR 2.38, 95% CI 2.01–2.82) and in 2019–2024 (OR 4.49, 95% CI 3.96–5.09), and delayed presentation (OR 1.43, 95% CI 1.32–1.55). The overall delayed presentation rate was 34.47%; independent risk factors included age 18–59 years (OR 1.37, 95% CI 1.24–1.52), exposure at home (OR 1.57, 95% CI 1.41–1.74), and presentation in 2018 (OR 1.61, 95% CI 1.40–1.86) and in 2019–2024 (OR 1.77, 95% CI 1.62–1.94). Conclusion RIG utilization was low and showed marked temporal variation during 2015–2024, and one third of patients presented more than 24 h after exposure. Both outcomes were concentrated among working-age adults and domestic exposure settings. These findings describe service utilization patterns and identify subgroups in which gaps in PEP delivery are concentrated; targeted risk communication and routine monitoring of RIG utilization and presentation timeliness are needed.

papers.title: Assessment of the Public's Knowledge, Attitudes, and Practices Regarding Rabies in the Republic of Guinea.
papers.abstract: Rabies remains a major public health problem in resource-limited countries, particularly in sub-Saharan Africa. The objective of this study was to assess the knowledge, attitudes, and practices (KAP) of the population regarding rabies in the Republic of Guinea. A cross-sectional study was conducted among 2733 participants in five regions (Boké, Kindia, Labé, Siguiri, and N'Zérékoré). Data were collected using a structured questionnaire administered via KoboCollect and then analyzed using DATAtab and R software. Descriptive analyses, chi-square tests, and multivariable logistic regression analyses were used to identify associated factors. In total, 66% of respondents had heard of rabies, but significant gaps were observed regarding modes of transmission and prevention measures. Dog bites were identified as the primary mode of transmission by 37.87% of participants. Canine vaccination was recognized as a preventive measure by 45.01% of respondents. Attitudes were predominantly poor (88.84% scored below the predefined 70% acceptability threshold, i.e., "low/unfavorable attitude," versus 10.79% moderate and 0.37% good), and 73.80% of participants exhibited inappropriate practices (versus 8.05% average and 18.15% good). Overall, 53.1% of respondents had a low level of knowledge, 29.3% an average level, and 17.6% a good level. A statistically significant association was observed between knowledge level and postexposure practices (p < 0.001). In a first multivariable logistic regression model (dependent variable: acceptable attitude, yes/no), educational level, age, and occupation were significantly associated with attitudes. In a second, separate multivariable model (dependent variable: dog bite, yes/no), none of the variables examined were significantly associated with dog bites, except age ≥ 50 years (adjusted OR = 1.98; 95% CI: 1.20-3.25; p = 0.006). These results highlight significant gaps in knowledge and practices related to rabies in Guinea. Strengthening targeted awareness campaigns, improving access to postexposure prophylaxis, and promoting canine vaccination are essential to reducing the burden of rabies. Because this study did not include animal, environmental, or surveillance data, an integrated "One Health" approach is recommended here as a forward-looking direction for future multisectoral intervention, rather than a conclusion directly supported by the present findings.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 对五个地区(博凯、金迪亚、拉贝、西吉里和恩泽雷科雷)的 2733 名参与者进行了一项横断面研究。
elements_zh.methods: 使用 KoboCollect 管理的结构化问卷收集数据,然后使用 DATAtab 和 R 软件进行分析。使用描述性分析、卡方检验和多变量逻辑回归分析来确定相关因素。
elements_zh.main_results: 66%的受访者听说过狂犬病,但在传播的模式和预防措施方面存在显着差距。37.87%的受访者认为狗咬伤是传播的主要方式,45.01%的受访者认为犬类疫苗接种是一种预防措施。总体而言,53.1%的受访者知识水平较低,29.3%的人知识水平一般,17.6%的人知识水平良好。在知识水平和暴露后实践之间观察到统计学上显着的关联(p < 0.001)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究强调了几内亚在与 狂犬病 相关的知识和实践方面存在的重大差距,强调需要开展有针对性的宣传活动、改善接触后预防的可及性以及推广犬类 狂犬病。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 加强有针对性的宣传活动、改善接触后预防的可及性以及推广犬类 狂犬病 对于减轻几内亚 狂犬病 的负担至关重要。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究不包括动物、环境或 监测 数据,这限制了根据目前的发现推荐综合“同一个健康”方法的能力。

papers.title: Knowledge, attitudes, and practices towards dog-associated zoonotic diseases among undergraduate health students, cleaning staff, and security personnel
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Zoonotic diseases are a major public health challenge in Ethiopia, particularly in rural and semi-urban areas where human-animal interaction is high. Dogs are the primary transmitters of several critical diseases, such as rabies, echinococcosis, and leishmaniasis. Despite these risks, there is limited research on the awareness levels of high-risk groups within academic settings. This study aims to bridge this gap by assessing the knowledge, attitudes, and practices regarding dog-associated zoonotic diseases among undergraduate health students, cleaning staff, and security personnel. Methods A cross-sectional study was conducted from April to June 2025, recruiting 424 participants through stratified random sampling with proportional allocation. Data were collected using a semi-structured questionnaire administered via face-to-face interviews and an online Kobo Toolbox link to assess participants’ knowledge, attitudes, and practices. The data were entered into Excel and analyzed using SPSS version 27, with results presented in tables and narrative summaries; chi-square (χ2) tests were used to assess associations, and p-values less than 0.05 were considered statistically significant. Result Among the 424 respondents, 91.7% (n = 389) were aged 18–29 years, with 48.6% (n = 206) females and 51.4% (n = 216) males; most had college/university education (92.0%, n = 390). The majority were undergraduate health students (90.1%, n = 382), followed by security personnel (6.6%, n = 28) and cleaning workers (3.3%, n = 14). Most respondents had heard of zoonosis (91.5%, n = 388), recognized animal-to-human disease transmission (96.2%, n = 408), identified viruses (32.1%, n = 136) and believed that dogs pose community risks (82.3%, n = 349) and are sources of parasitic infections (84.9%, n = 360). Conclusion The most participants demonstrated good awareness and positive attitudes toward dog-associated zoonotic diseases. However, gaps in knowledge among some respondents highlight the need for targeted education to promote safer human–animal interactions.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在解决学术环境中缺乏对高危人群对与狗相关的人畜共患疾病的认识水平的研究的问题。人畜共患疾病是埃塞俄比亚的一项重大公共卫生挑战,特别是在人与动物互动频繁的农村和城乡结合部地区。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 2025 年 4 月至 6 月进行了一项横断面研究,通过按比例分配的分层随机抽样招募了 424 名参与者。大多数是卫生本科生(90.1%,n = 382),其次是保安人员(6.6%,n = 28)和清洁工人(3.3%,n = 14)。
elements_zh.methods: 使用半结构化问卷收集数据,该问卷通过面对面访谈和在线 Kobo Toolbox 链接进行管理,以评估参与者的知识、态度和实践。将数据输入 Excel 并使用 SPSS 27 版进行分析,结果以表格和叙述性摘要的形式呈现;卡方 (χ2) 检验用于评估关联性,p 值小于 0.05 被认为具有统计显着性。
elements_zh.main_results: 在 424 名受访者中,91.7% (n = 389) 年龄在 18-29 岁,其中女性占 48.6% (n = 206),男性占 51.4% (n = 216);大多数人受过大学教育(92.0%,n = 390)。大多数受访者听说过人兽共患病(91.5%,n = 388),认识到动物传染人类的疾病传播(96.2%,n = 408),识别出病毒(32.1%,n = 136),并认为狗会带来社区风险(82.3%,n = 349)并且是寄生虫感染的来源(84.9%,n = 360)。
